scope: Counts and claim classes reproducible from the frozen catalog, frozen oracle ledger, and Package03C answer contract.

boundaries.claim_level_evidence_contract: Numeric and dataset claims receive structured evidence refs; conceptual rejections and limits receive prompt/catalog/contract refs.
unsupported_claim_classes: private establishment profit or unit-level rent or individual health records
future values described as actual observations
boundaries.retraction_policy: Retract unsupported causal, individual-level, universal-absence, and internal-system claims. Retain only reported facts and calculations with explicit operands and formulas.
